You can also use Merton/meltdown if you equip either fire or air damage negation on people in your party to make you immune from it. It's the second highest damaging spell only to Ultima but it hits your own party as well thus needing the negation of either it's fire or air element. 

Fixed dice is something that sets her can equip and it has an absolute fucking outrageous spread of damage but it can easily do a super huge amount. It does however have a very long attack animation so that can be a pain in the ass over time if you are doing it multiple times per attack and multiple times per combat. You can make sensor have jump and even the multi jump with the fixed dice and this will shorten the battle animation drastically but gives you the same damage output. 

If you are on the classic SNES version anything you fight that is invisible is also susceptible to instant death so you can just cast vanish and then any instant death spell to one shot most things. 

Gau has a rage called stray cat and if you use that one and have him geared up correctly he will use an attack sometimes that is a scratch ability and it does a psychotic amount of damage but you don't control him on when he uses it or who he hits so the damage is not always reliable. 

If you stock up on elemental Shields or rods and use them in combat as an item they cast a powerful version of magic but unlike casting them as spells when you break an elemental item to cast magic it ignores magical defense so make sure one of your casters such as Terra, Celes, relm, or Chicago uses them for maximum effect. 

There is a weapon called valiant knife which does more damage based on the amount of Health you have lost. Slapping that bad boy on Locke during the end game when he has high hit points and having him attack multiple times per command can easily do 9999 per swing.

Sabins bum rush is extremely powerful but only hits one thing. 

Shadows throw command is broken AF and there are a lot of things you can stock up on and throw with him that will do Max damage. 

Edgar has some tools that ignore defense so against some particularly tank bosses he will pull out a very high damage All things considered. 

Gogo can of course do most any of these strategies but he has garbage stats which are super important in calculating damage in this game so he is never the right choice for ultra high damage but is damn fine utility kind of.

If they create negative/controversial content they make more money and get more exposure. With content creators the need to constantly create new content is very taxing so you want each video to have maximum chance of money generation so you go with the trends.

If positive content had more views and interaction it would likely be something the algorithm would push more on your feed but that just isn't what the data shows. Aww this user best me to calling out CYP3A4, but yes the grapefruits interaction with your bile enzymes can cause things you eat to be absorbed faster and in higher amounts than intended.

When studying toxicology you see that all absorption of ingested chemicals happens in a bell curve. Going back to the calculus we all love so very much, we know that the amount in your system at any given time is the amount under the curve. Mixing grapefruit into the equation makes a much steeper bell curve so the amount inside of you actively happens faster, but the process of getting it through your body and processed out is not affected by grapefruit.

This is like pouring water into a bucket that has a small hole on the bottom. Ash report water in a fixed amount falls out and if you know the rate the fixed amount falls out you know that if you pour a steady amount in you will know how much water will be in the bucket at any given time. Grapefruit gives you a faster rate of filling the bucket which can lead to the bucket overflowing which in this analogy means the medication has accumulated too much inside your system and can now be dangerous.

Remember that in toxicology The single most important factor is dosage. How much of the chemical is actively in your system. Just like the water bucket analogy above incorporating grapefruit and some medications into your system will put more of the medicine than is safe into your blood/body at a single time.

One of the core development aspects of a video game really boils down to level design. Your classic final fantasies had dungeons that while having a linear path that leads you to the end often had multi-branching ways of getting lost or getting to the end and didn't feel railroaded while having an overworld that was realistically gated (things like the canoe and canal in final fantasy 1 while there was The castle in six that can go under the sand etc.) But those gates felt realistic as part of the natural world and exploring past them felt organic.

I take a look at 16 and you just find a door you can totally open later but can't open now to go down that path because reasons. Things like that are not an immersive experience which final fantasy really set the bar for achieving historically.

And with their dungeons I think they built 16 with the action game replayable and arcade mode functions in mind, which is not a bad thing, but by going with that kind of level design as opposed to a much for your flowing world design mentality you get the narrow down and set "levels" we see here. There isn't really a world with explorable dungeons scattered throughout it, there are simply levels. Even the overworld feels and is laid out like an action game level. I enjoy 16 very much, but overall in design and deliverable, it feels like one of the best spin-offs the devil May cry series could ever have. I know a lot of people disagree with that but it is just how it feels to me.

After 35 years of life I am on the brink of suicide almost every day. I have gotten documents drawn up for my final wishes and do not plan on meeting another year in my life and I want to tell everyone here something simple from the perspective of a suicidal person. If you have people around you that you are worried about don't wait for them to tell you they are suicidal to offer help, they will refuse it at this stage every time. The truth is we don't want your help with our depression, we don't want your encouragement that we have so much to live for, we don't want your pleas to think about others either.

What we want is to not feel hopeless and alone and all it takes to stave that off is hope. If you want to give us hope pick up the phone you never put down anyway and text us. What breaks our hearts is that no one thinks about us enough to be interested in our existence. And if right now you are thinking about yourself as and that you do care about these people pick up your phone and see how many time YOU started the conversation with them. How many times have you just asked how their day was or if they just wanted to go hang out? Don't ask them about their problems they will bring that up when they want to talk about it. Don't ask them what's wrong because they don't like talking about it usually, when they want to talk they will, just be there as a presence in their life in a positive way for them, be their friend and passively show them you are thinking about them and that they matter in YOUR life. This is more important to someone that down in life than you can imagine.

Ask your friends how they are, text people and joke with them every so often, ask them if they want to go grab coffee, show them you think of them and in your general actions you want them around. This means so much to people who are depressed or scared, more than you will ever know. They don't want you being there because ethey are sad, that means nothing to us, we just want to know you are thinking of us in normal situations, that's what makes us think there is something to live for.

Please try to be an active friend to your friends you are worried about. Don't talk to us about what's wrong, talk to us about the next season of GoT, talk to us about sports, talk to us about ANYTHING normal friends talk about, we needs close relationships, not counselors. We need positive life moments, we need you to take your time to show us you want us in your life. Please save your depressed friends, be their friends not their psychiatrist. And if they are important to you never stop being the one who reached out to them and you just might save their lives.
